fnol_text: My name is Olusegun Laurent and I live at 948 Larkspur Court, Riverton, WY 82555. You can reach me on (555) 937-8581 or olusegun.laurent@example.com. On 9 June 2025 the Stonebridge Brook overtopped near our house after a week of storms. River water flooded the downstairs rooms and the garage. Policy HH-2023-00054. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Can you confirm I'm covered for this?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Laurent on (555) 937-8581 to acknowledge the claim. Olusegun confirmed the loss date as 9 June 2025.
Site visit to 948 Larkspur Court. Neighbour Tariq Moreau was present and confirmed the timeline.
Olusegun sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
